title: FixtureManifest
description: Immutable manifest anchoring committed trace seals for offline fixture verification; verification must be supplied a trusted manifest commit/tree hash out-of-band and reject if manifest does not match

trusted_manifest_commit_oid.description: Trusted git commit OID (40 hex for sha1, 64 for sha256) anchoring this manifest per repository object format; verifier must be supplied this OID independently, resolve it to its tree, read fixture-manifest.json from that trusted tree at canonical path, and reject unless checked-out manifest bytes are identical to trusted-tree bytes; separate canonical content hash is manifest_identity_sha256 if needed (not alternative to OID)

manifest_identity_sha256.description: Optional canonical content identity sha256(canonical_json({manifest_version, entries})) omitting commit OID; not a substitute for trusted commit OID
